machineVercel.description: Sandboxes that keep their files between runs.
machineVercel.timeoutDescription: Leave empty to use your plan maximum: 45 minutes on Hobby; 24 hours on Pro and Enterprise. Enter a shorter duration if needed. Happier does not extend runs automatically.
machineVercel.retentionDescription: Use 0 for no expiry. Retained snapshots are billed after the sandbox stops.
machineVercel.tokenDescription: Create a team-scoped token (All Projects) under Account settings, then Tokens. Project-scoped tokens cannot read team plan limits.
machineVercel.teamIdDescription: Find it in Vercel, under Team settings.
machineVercel.projectIdDescription: Find it in Vercel, under Project settings.
machineVercel.checkUnavailable: Vercel account unavailable. Check the token, team, and project.
machineVercel.confirmBody: Vercel bills running compute and retained snapshots. Files can persist across runs; process memory cannot.
machineVercel.deleteBody: Deletes this sandbox and its owned snapshots. Its files cannot be recovered after deletion.
